translations.web: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
translations.bsb: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
translations.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
